description.en: The display name of the Agent.
The host address of the Agent.

description.zh: AgentID，经过CNNIC实名认证后，由CNNIC统一分配。AgentID作为Agent与实名认证注册人绑定的唯一标识
description.en: The Agent ID, which is uniformly assigned by CNNIC after real-name verification through CNNIC. The AgentID serves as the unique identifier that binds the Agent to the real-name verified registrant.

description.zh: 保证请求幂等性。从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符，且不能超过64个字符。
description.en: Ensures the idempotency of the request. Generate a unique parameter value from your client to ensure that the value is unique across different requests. ClientToken supports only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length.

description.zh: 本次请求所返回的最大记录条数。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return in this request.
The token for the next query.

description.zh: 当前页数，起始值为1，默认为1。
description.en: The current page number. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.
The page size for the paged query. This parameter specifies the number of entries per page for paging.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alidns list-ati-agent-register-infos --client-token eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1NiIsInR5cC..... --page-size 2 --page-number 1 --agent-id liuq@azt400 --agent-display-name '测试Agent' --agent-host www.example.com --agent-version 1.0.0 --status '活跃' --max-results 100 --next-token 4698691 --region cn-hangzhou
